origin: Named after the English logician John Venn, who introduced it in 1880.
whenToUse: You show how much two or three groups overlap.
The intersection matters, as with overlapping consents or repeat purchases.
You show the exact count in each region too.
whenNotToUse: There are four or more sets.
Overlap ratios must be compared precisely by area.
Comparing groups that don't overlap (use a bar chart).
accessibility: Legend buttons announce the selected state with aria-pressed.
The total of the chosen set is read via aria-live.
Every region's count is also kept as a list for screen readers.
